sentences.text:
The applicant was arrested on 13/03/2022 by Police Station- Godan, District- Datia (M.P.) in connection with Crime No.18/2022 for the offence punishable under Sections 354, 363, 366, 376-D,
376(2), 376(3) and 506 of IPC and Sections 3/4, 5L/6 and 17 of POCSO Act.

Prosecution story, in short, is that complainant- Ashok Sharma lodged the report that on 06/02/2022 at about 3:00 PM when he came back to his home, he did not find his daughter aged about 15 years at home.
Thereafter, he searched her in his relatives but of no avail.

Thereafter,
missing report was registered against unknown person.

Thereafter, prosecutrix was recovered and her statement was recorded in which she stated that she is studying in 10th standard and 3-4 months ago, she used to visit Hanuman temple where she met with Sandeep Rajak.
Thereafter, they started talking each other on mobile phones.
After sometime, Sandeep went to Jaipur to work and he said the prosecutrix to come there to marry with him.
Sandeep said that we would marry silently and after some time, we would tell their families and you come with the present applicant- Vikram.
Thereafter, present applicant talked the prosecutrix and called her at Bhalka.

At about 3-4 o'clock,
when she was alone at home, she kept some wearing cloths and took out Rs.1,00,000/- from box and by taking them, reached at Bhalka.
From there, she called the present applicant by mobile phone of unknown person.
Thereafter, present applicant came there and took her to the house of Ravi Jatav at Bahadurpur and said that we would go to Jaipur tomorrow as train is available tomorrow.
Thereafter, at about 8-9 PM, applicant and co-accused- Ravi committed rape with her forcefully and threatened her to kill.
After that, on the next day, they left her at Indargarh and did not give Rs.1,00,000/- of the prosecutrix.
She did not narrate about rape committed by the present applicant and co-accused- Ravi Jatav to the police as they threatened her to kill.
After recording the statement before the Court, when she reached at home, she narrated the incident to her family members.
On the basis of aforesaid, crime has been registered against the applicant.

Thereafter,
applicant was arrested on 13/03/2022 and after investigation, charge-sheet has been submitted.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is aged 20 years and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
After investigation, charge sheet has been submitted.

It is further submitted that statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. of the prosecutrix was recorded in which she did not support the prosecution case and thereafter, again statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. was recorded in which she stated that present applicant committed rape with her.
The applicant is in custody since 13/03/2022 and he is the permanent resident of District- Datia (M.P.).
There is no likelihood of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
The applicant is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for grant of bail is made.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor for the State opposed the application and prayed for dismissal of the application.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the Vikram Jaat vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/61039578/
